showcase.song2.title: Don't Look Back

showcase.subtitle: A sunset, a car in a garage, friends on a jet ski — each photo inspires unique lyrics, melody, and vocals. Press play to hear real songs generated by the app.
showcase.title: Every photo becomes a song
preview.label: App Preview
preview.title: Watch SnapSong in action

preview.video1: Create a song from a photo
howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.step1.desc: Snap a new photo or pick one from your library. A sunset, your pet, a concert — any moment works. That's the only required step.
howItWorks.step1.title: Choose a Photo
howItWorks.step2.desc: Want more control? Add keywords to guide the AI — a name, a feeling, a memory. The song becomes even more personal and accurate.
howItWorks.step2.title: Add Context (Optional)
howItWorks.step3.desc: Your unique song with original lyrics and vocals is ready in minutes. Play it, read the lyrics, and share it anywhere.
howItWorks.step3.title: Listen & Share
howItWorks.title: Pick a photo. That's it.
features.appClip.desc: Create a song instantly — no download required. Scan an App Clip Code or tap a link, and SnapSong opens a lightweight experience to generate music from any photo on the spot.
features.appClip.title: App Clip
features.design.desc: Designed with the iOS 26 Liquid Glass visual language. Translucent materials, fluid animations, and depth throughout every screen.
features.design.title: Liquid Glass Design
features.iMessage.desc: Send songs directly in your conversations. Pick a photo from the chat, generate a song, and share it as a rich message — all without leaving iMessage.
features.iMessage.title: iMessage App
features.interactiveWidgets.desc: Compact widgets that live right between your app icons. Start a new song or play your latest creation with a single tap — without ever opening the app.
features.interactiveWidgets.title: Interactive Widgets
features.label: Features
features.languages.desc: Songs and lyrics generated in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, and German — auto-detected from your device language.
features.languages.title: 5 Languages
features.liveActivity.desc: Watch your song being created in real-time on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. You'll know exactly when it's ready.
features.liveActivity.title: Live Activity & Dynamic Island
features.platforms.desc: Available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Apple Silicon. Your songs everywhere you go.
features.platforms.title: iPhone, iPad & Mac
features.siri.desc: "Hey Siri, create a song." Full Shortcuts integration for hands-free music creation from any photo.
features.siri.title: Siri & Shortcuts
features.smartSuggestions.desc: The app learns your style over time. It suggests fresh ideas, detects repetitive patterns, and recommends new genres — all privately on your device, powered by Apple Intelligence.
features.smartSuggestions.title: Smart Suggestions
features.title: More than you'd expect
features.twoVersions.desc: Every photo generates two unique song versions — different styles, different vibes. Pick your favorite or keep both.
features.twoVersions.title: Two Versions Per Song
features.visionPro.desc: A spatial experience for creating and listening to your songs in an entirely new dimension. SnapSong reimagined for Apple Vision Pro.
features.visionPro.title: Apple Vision Pro
features.widgets.desc: Your latest songs and generation status live right on your Home Screen. Quick access without opening the app.
features.widgets.title: Home Screen Widgets
useCases.creators.desc: Original, royalty-free music from your own photos. Perfect for videos, reels, and stories.
useCases.creators.title: Content Creators
useCases.gifts.desc: Create personalized songs for friends and family. A photo of them becomes their song.
useCases.gifts.title: Unique Gifts
useCases.label: Made For
useCases.moments.desc: Your pet, your coffee, your backyard. Even the simplest photos make surprisingly great songs.
useCases.moments.title: Everyday Moments
useCases.title: Songs for every moment
useCases.travel.desc: Turn your travel photos into musical memories you'll want to replay forever.
useCases.travel.title: Travel Memories
trust.accessibility.desc: Built to be usable by everyone, from day one. Not as an afterthought — as a foundation.
trust.accessibility.title: Accessible to Everyone
trust.privacy.desc: All data collected is not linked to your identity. Songs, photos, and personal data are stored locally on your device. Apple Intelligence features run entirely on-device — nothing is sent to the cloud.
trust.privacy.title: Privacy First
madeBy.text: Built by Henrique Velloso — indie developer from Brazil, 3× WWDC Scholar, and Apple Developer Academy alumnus. Building apps for Apple platforms for over a decade.
finalCta.subtitle: Download SnapSong and turn any moment into music.
finalCta.title.line2: You just haven't heard it yet.
meta.title: SnapSong — Turn Photos into Music
meta.description: SnapSong transforms any photo into an original song with AI. Point your camera, get a unique song with custom lyrics in seconds.
meta.ogDescription: Point your camera at any moment. Get an original song with custom lyrics in seconds.
